task: Noklateo layout patternId classification from one image
protocol_note: One image exists per patternId in the uploaded dataset, so this project is implemented as a closed-set template matcher. Deterministic train/val/test splits are defined over augmentation-based query images while keeping the full gallery fixed; this avoids an impossible unseen-pattern split for a one-template-per-class dataset.

calibration.split_protocol: deterministic augmentation queries with full gallery fixed; one template per patternId in dataset
